about_the_game:
■Conquer the Game with Your Favorite Among 300+ VTubers!

Over 300 VTubers from various genres—game streaming, singing, ASMR, illustration, and more—join the battle! What’s more, every VTuber featured in the game can be used as your main playable character!

■Extensive Collection Features

Each of the 300+ VTubers has their own cards of different rarities!

Try to collect all the cards of your favorite VTuber and complete your collection!

■Game System

This game combines elements of card battles, auto-battles, and roguelite progression. Players assemble a set of five cards to strengthen stats such as HP, ATK, DEF, MAG, MDEF, and SPD, defeat rivals, and acquire stronger cards as they take on increasingly powerful opponents.

■Skills, Levels, and a Role for Every Card!

The strength of a card depends on its level and rarity—not on the character itself. Even cards of the same character differ by level, and higher-rarity cards come with additional skills. This system ensures that every card has a chance to shine in battle.

About the Demo Version

・Only the EASY difficulty is available.

・You can select from 105 VTubers featured in Volumes 1–3 only.

・Collection features are available exclusively in the full version.

■Estimated Play Time

1–2 hours to complete one full run.

Including card and skill collection, there are over 20 hours of gameplay available!

■For Live Streamers

Regarding Monetization

Monetized live streaming and video uploads of this game are fully permitted. You are free to earn revenue through video-sharing sites or live-streaming platforms.

Regarding Stream Content

You are allowed to show any scene from the game in your videos or streams.

Additional Notes

As long as your live streams fall within general, appropriate usage, there are no special restrictions. However, since this game features many VTubers, please remember to treat all participants with respect.
